content: भ्रंशः, -सः [भ्रंश् भावे घञ्] .²1 Falling off, dropping down, fall, slipping or falling down; सेहेऽस्य न भ्रंशमतो न लोभात् <ls>R. 16. 74</ls>; कनकवलयभ्रंशरिक्तप्रकोष्ठः <ls>Me. 2</ls>. .²2 Decline, decrease, decay. .²3 Fall, destruction, ruin, overthrow. .²4 Running away. .²5 Disappearance. .²6 Losing, loss, deprivation; स्मृतिभ्रंशाद् बुद्धिनाशः <ls>Bg. 2. 63</ls>; so जातिभ्रंश, स्वार्थभ्रंश. .²7 Straying, swerving, or deviating from. .²8 Abandoning, deserting. .²9 (In drama) A slip of the tongue (due to excitement).
